senses.gloss:
a. 
(-री f.) [पुरे बसति शौषिको अण्] 
__1 Relating to a city or town, produced in a town, civic. 
__2 Ved. Filling one's own belly. 
-रः 
__1 A townsman, citizen, (opp. जानपद); [[Ku. 6. 41]]; [[R. 2. 10]], 74; 12. 3; 16. 9. 
__2 A term applied to a prince engaged in war under particular circumstances. 
__3 A planet in a state of opposition to other planets. 
-री The language of the servants in a palace. 
-रम् A sort of grass (रोहिष). 
-Comp. 
-अङ्ना, -योषित् f., 
-स्त्री a woman living in a town; विद्युद्दामस्फुरितचकितैर्यत्र पौराङ्गनानां लोलापाङ्गैर्यदि न रमसे लोचनैर्वञ्चितोऽसि [[Me. 27.]] 
-कार्यम् public business; अर्थजातस्य गणनाबहुलतयैकमेव पौरकार्यमवेक्षितम् [[Ś. 6.]] 
-जनः, -लोकः 
__1 a citizen. 
__2 citizens, burghers. 
-जानपद a. belonging to town and country. 
-दाः (pl.) citizens and rustics, townsmen and country people; कथं दुर्जनाः पौरजानपदाः [[U. 1.]] 
-वृद्धः an eminent citizen, an elder man. 
-सख्यम् fellow-citizenship; दशाब्दाख्यं पौरसख्यम् [[Ms. 2. 134.]]

__1 A garden near a house. 
__2 A garden near a town.

__1 A citizen. 
__2 A governor of a city.
A country in the South.

a. 
(-यी f.) Civic, town-bred.

a. 
(-री) Derived from or sacred to Indra. 
-रम् The lunar mansion called ज्येष्ठा.
a. Feminine.

a. 
(-वी f.) [पुरोर्गोत्रापत्यम् अण्] Descended from Puru; पौरवेणाथ वयसा राजा यौवनमास्थितः [[Mb. 1. 75. 46.]] 
-वः 
__1 A descendant of Puru; [[Ś. 5. 2]] N. of a country or people in the north of India. 
__2 An inhabitant or ruler of that country.

a. 
(-यी f.) Devoted to Paurava.

a. [पुरस्-भवार्थे त्यक् अण् च] 
__1 Eastern; पौरस्त्यो वा सुखयति मरुत् साधुसंबाहनाभिः [[Māl. 9. 25]]; पौरस्त्यझामरुत् 9. 17; [[R. 4. 34.]] 
__2 Foremost. 
__3 Prior, first, preceding.

a. 
(-णी f.) [पुराण-अण्] 
__1 Belonging to the past, ancient, of the past, primeval. 
__2 Relating to the Purāṇas or derived from them. 
__3 Former, previous.

a. 
(-की f.) [पुराण-ठक्] 
__1 Belonging to the past, ancient. 
__2 Belonging to the Purāṇas or derived from them. 
__3 Versed in the legends of the past. 
__4 Versed in the science of architecture (शिल्पशास्त्र); [[Mb. 1. 51. 15]] (com.). 
-कः 
__1 A Brāhmaṇa well-versed in the Purāṇas, a public reader of the Purāṇas. 
__2 A mythologist.

a. 
(-षी f.) [पुरुष अण्] 
__1 Relating to a man or man in general, human. 
__2 Manly, virile. 3 Secred to Puruṣa. 
-षः A weight which can be carried by one man; [[Ms. 8. 404.]] 
-षी A woman. 
-षम् 
__1 Human action, man's work, exertion, effort; धिग् धिग् वृथा पौरुषम् [[Bh. 2. 88]]; दैवं निहत्य कुरु पौरुषमात्मशक्त्या [[Pt. 1. 361]]; 2. 85. 
__2 
___(a) Heroism, prowess, valour, manliness, courage; पौरुषभूषणः [[R. 15. 28]]; 8. 28. 
___(b) Strength, power, vigour. 
__3 Virility; पौरुषं नृषु [[Bg. 7. 8]]; स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम् [[Rām. 7. 87. 29.]] 
__4 Semen virile. 
__5 Penis. 
__6 The full height of a man, the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated and the fingers extended; जवेऽपि मानेऽपि च पौरुषाधिकम् [[N. 1. 57.]] 
__7 Sun-dial.
A worshipper of Puruṣa.

a. 
(-यी f.) [पुरुष-ठञ्] 
__1 Derived from or belonging to man, human, incidental to man; made, established or propounded by man; as in अपौरुषेया वै वेदाः. 
__2 Manly, virile. 
__3 Spiritual. 
-यः 
__1 Manslaughter [Page1051-1] (पुरुषवध). 
__2 A crowd of men. 
__3 A day-labourer, hireling. 
__4 Human action, man's work. 
__5 Law as affecting persons. 
-यम् Human work, action of man.
Manliness, courage, heroism; किमार्य कामस्य वशंगतेन किमात्मपौरुष्यपराभवेन [[Rām. 4. 30. 16.]]

a. 
(-ती f.) Belonging to Indra; अस्याधिज्ये धनुषि विजयं पौरुहूते च वज्रे [[Ś. 2. 16.]]
A superintendent of the royal household; especially, of the royal kitchen; पौरोगवः सूदाध्यक्षः [[Abh. Chin. 722.]]
A Mantra recited upon making an oblation of ghee.
A priest who repeats the above Mantra.
The office of a family-priest; पौरोधसं हृष्यति येन दुर्मतिः [[Bhāg. 6. 7. 37.]]

__1 Fault-finding, censoriousness; प्रियोपभोगचिह्नेषु पौरोभाग्यमिवाचरन् [[R. 12. 22.]] 
__2 Ill-will, envy, jealousy. 
__3 An ill-natured act, mischievous deed; किमिदमनुष्ठितं पौरोभाग्यम् [[Ś. 6.]] 
__4 Obtrusiveness.
The office of a family-priest; नरकाय मतिस्ते चेत् पौरोहित्यं समाचर [[Pt. 2. 63.]]

a. 
(-सी f.) Relating to the full moon. 
-सः A ceremony performed on the full-moon day by one who maintains the sacred fire (अग्निहोत्रिन्); दर्शपौर्णमासाभ्यां यजेत [[ŚB. on MS. 6.]] 
-सम् A day of full-moon.

पौर्णमासी,
 
-पौर्णमी A day of full-moon.
A sacrifice performed on the full-moon day.
An ascetic.
A day of full moon.

पौर्त,
पौर्तिक a. 
(-की f.) Relating to acts of pious charity; आशीर्युक्तानि कर्माणि पौर्तानि विविधानि च [[Mb. 14. 37. 9]]; तावतां न भवेद् दातुः फलं दानस्य पौर्तिकम् [[Ms. 3. 178.]]

पौर्व,
पौर्वक a. 
(-र्वी f.) 
__1 Relating to the past. 
__2 Relating to the east, eastern. 
__3 Coming in succession (परंपरागत); एतैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्नित्यमृत्विजस्तस्य पौर्वकाः [[Rām. 1. 7. 6.]]

पौर्वदे(दै)हिक
a. 
(-की f.) Relating to a former existence, done in a former life; तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् [[Bg. 6. 43]]; [[Y. 1. 349.]]

a. 
(-की f.) Relating to the first member of a compound.

__1 The relation of prior and posterior. 
__2 Due order, succession, continuity.

a. 
(-की f.) Relating to the forenoon; व्युषितो रजनीं चाहं कृत्बा पौर्वाह्णिकीः क्रियाः [[Mb. 3. 168. 2.]]

पौर्वार्ध,
पौर्वार्धक, पौर्वार्धिक a. Belonging to or situated to the east of.

a. 
(-की f.) 
__1 Previous, former, prior; जातिं स्मरति पौर्विकीम् [[Ms. 4. 148.]] 
__2 Ancestral. 
__3 Old, ancient.
